# Douyin Xingtu Author Show Items API

Retrieves the video catalog for a specified Douyin Xingtu author using `o_author_id`. You can also filter results by `flow_type`, `platform_source`, `platform_channel`, and `only_assign`.

## Use cases

- Review video portfolios for specific Douyin Xingtu authors.
- Filter author video showcases down to assigned Xingtu marketing videos.
- Analyze author content distributions across different platform channels.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/xingtu-v2/author-show-items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"o_author_id": "7589271892177518598"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `o_author_id` | string | Yes | Creator/author ID |
| `flow_type` | integer | No | Flow type, default 0 |
| `only_assign` | boolean | No | Only show assigned videos (only for XingTu videos), default False |
| `platform_source` | integer | No | Platform source, default 1 |
| `platform_channel` | integer | No | Platform channel, default 1 |

## Notes

- `o_author_id` is required to identify the target author.
- Set `only_assign` to true to return only assigned Xingtu videos (defaults to false).
- `platform_source` and `platform_channel` default to 1, while `flow_type` defaults to 0.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
